title: Application handbook
release_statement: Engineering review edition. No powered vehicle application or handheld mode is qualified by this guide.

modes.title: V1 boat: bench and legacy RC
modes.summary: Preserve and reproduce the existing image, identify the reversed header roles and measure unloaded PWM and legacy packet behavior.
available_now: Reproducible preserved-source V1 build and backup/programming instructions
Source-backed connector map and exact UART test lines
Unloaded startup, command and link-loss characterization procedure
release_gates: Board-specific electrical corrections and verified harness power
Integrated control supervisor, parser and watchdog correction
Measured startup, link-loss and fault response with selected hardware
modes.next_task: Integrate a reviewed supervisor and receive parser into a separate board-specific candidate, then measure unloaded output/fault behavior.

modes.title: V2 boat controller
modes.summary: One ESC and steering servo with intended local supervision, power monitoring and navigation; operational firmware and physical acceptance remain required.
available_now: Annotated CAD, assembly references and candidate parts
Stage A identity diagnostic source and reproducible build workflow
Electrical pin contract review and staged operator acceptance procedure
release_gates: Accepted electrical design and frozen assembly
Board-specific diagnostic and control firmware with matching peer
Measured failsafe, power and navigation acceptance
modes.next_task: Resolve electrical holds, freeze the pin/protocol contract and validate an initial diagnostic image with actuator outputs inactive.

modes.title: Rover with ESC and steering servo
modes.summary: Adapt the vehicle outputs for one ESC and steering servo, with an explicit neutral/brake/reverse contract for the selected drivetrain.
available_now: Parts, startup, shutdown and acceptance checklist
release_gates: Implemented rover profile and matching peer controls
Measured stop, reset, reconnect and steering-limit behavior
modes.next_task: Select one ESC/servo pair and document its pulse, neutral and braking behavior before implementing the rover profile.

modes.title: Remote position and telemetry
modes.summary: V1 emits basic GPS coordinates; a useful tracking profile needs fresh-fix handling, unit identity, receiver state and bounded reporting.
available_now: Exact V1 position-payload and UART behavior
Unloaded GNSS/radio capture and stale-fix demonstration procedure
release_gates: Dedicated tracker profile with control outputs inactive
modes.next_task: Implement and replay-test fix invalidation, then define identity/fix-age telemetry and an explicit stale/offline receiver display.

modes.title: Handheld voice, text and location
modes.summary: A two-endpoint communicator with voice, text delivery and location status; voice/RC coexistence must be measured before radio and audio hardware selection.
available_now: Required user flows and delivery/failure states
Two-endpoint prototype and coexistence acceptance plan
release_gates: Agreed voice mode and measurable timing/quality limits
Released handheld hardware, firmware, power and peer implementation
modes.next_task: Run a repeatable two-endpoint audio/airtime experiment against explicit speech and RC limits before selecting radio, codec and pins.
